profile.headline: Software Engineer - OMNI
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer building applications and secure API platforms for federal and healthcare environments. My work spans React and TypeScript interfaces, Python services, and the identity and authorization systems that connect users, services, and data.

At Omni Federal, I develop software supporting federal programs, with a particular focus on federated authentication and fine-grained authorization. I’ve helped design and implement systems using Keycloak, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, OpenFGA, and policy-based access controls. I enjoy turning complex security requirements into working software that teams can understand, operate, and extend.

Previously, at Bayview Physicians Group, I built tools used across daily clinical and administrative operations, including a dashboard serving approximately 1,000 daily users, a front-desk application supporting roughly 300 staff, and IoT infrastructure spanning 23 locations. That experience shaped how I approach engineering: understand the workflow, solve the underlying problem, and build something people can depend on.

Before moving into software, I worked in emergency management and fire and EMS. Those roles taught me to communicate clearly, make decisions under pressure, and take ownership of outcomes—habits I bring to development, technical collaboration, and mentoring.I’m especially interested in work where full-stack development, distributed systems, and security meet.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as the platform’s AuthN/AuthZ SME, designing and implementing a multi-realm federated identity architecture across Tyk, Keycloak, OPA, and external OIDC providers. Used RFC 7523 JWT grants and X.509 client authentication to issue locally governed API entitlements while preserving request-time third-party ABAC context.

Designed and built an OpenFGA-backed authorization layer for the gateway control plane, modeling hierarchical Organization → System → API permissions and enforcing access across UI and API routes.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · OpenID Connect (OIDC) · SAML 2.0 · Keycloak · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained internal software supporting clinical and administrative operations across a multi-site healthcare organization.
• Built a dashboard serving approximately 1,000 daily users, giving staff access to operational information in a shared interface.
• Developed a front-desk application used by approximately 300 staff to support workflows handling peak volumes of roughly 1,500 calls per hour.
• Built and maintained IoT server infrastructure spanning 23 locations.• Delivered applications and services using TypeScript, Rust, Tauri, Deno, Hono, SQL Server, and Docker.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Software Development · Cloud Development · Node.js · JavaScript · TypeScript

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
●​ Built a full-stack website using NextJS with a focus on spam reduction, utilizing an algorithmic
approach to assign scores to marketing submissions to highlight potential spam to marketing
professionals. (NextJs, Cron)
●​ Delivered an integration with a non-profit that harnessed a sorting algorithm to
match mentors and mentees together quickly and efficiently. (Express, Node,
React)

positions.title: Local Health Emergency Manager
positions.description:
Served as the Emergency Manager across 4 localities in the Western Tidewater Health District in the high-pressure and dynamic environment of the COVID-19 pandemic. Coordinated all aspects of the health department response to COVID 19. Successfully served the citizens of Tidewater by organizing more than 200 successful clinic operations focused on underserved communities, supervising approximately 30 staff and administering approximately 115,000 vaccines with 100% dose retention. 
Served as the Public Information Officer. Experience included submitting strategic communications plans to the Incident Commander, executing strategic communications on Facebook, Nextdoor, and Wordpress to provide timely updates to the public on COVID related issues, executing multiple on-camera interviews, print interviews, and press-releases in relation to the emerging COVID-19 threat. Established a Social Media Monitoring team of 10 volunteers geared towards combating mis-information and rumor control through the MRC utilizing TweetDeck. 
Onboarded Volunteers to the Medical Reserve Corps including orienting them to VVHS, a SAAS tool that managed time-tracking, certification renewal, and volunteer alerting. Ran  ongoing training orientation meetings for all volunteers. Managed recruiting, onboarding, training, and administered a rapidly growing medical reserve corps that saw 125% growth over the pandemic.
Led training of volunteers and staff to be both users and admins in the VAMS, a SAAS software developed by the CDC amidst a rapidly developing pandemic. Experience effectively troubleshooting newly developed enterprise software designed to track and report the nation's vaccine usage.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Communications · Onboarding · Volunteer Management · Site Planning · Emergency Management

positions.title: Marketing Manager - Internship
positions.description:
Functioned as the Marketing Manager for a SAAS startup in absence of the full time marketing manager. Executed marketing plans to include multiple direct marketing campaigns. Accomplishing a follower growth of ~150% on social media platforms.
Experience working directly with SAAS software, utilizing demo spaces to capture visual-aids resulting in the development of a troubleshooting page for the company website. 
Wrote and edited blog posts to provide insight to the cloud computing world ensuring the complex was  easily consumed by and relevant to potential clients. Utilized Search Engine Optimization to continue website and social media growth for the company.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked on a team to write and submit proposals to the Government. Experience with Microsoft Office, SharePoint, and multiple presentation mediums. Gained experience in Marketing, working with other interns in developing a website to reflect a re-branding process.

volunteerExperiences.description: Certification in Emergency Medical response. Served as an aide on an ambulance crew for 1 year. Served as an EMT on an ambulance crew for 3 years. EVOC Certified.

Earned Firefighter I and II certification in July of 2014 and joined the LVFC. Serves as a part of the fire company. Responds to and has specific certifications for many types of emergencies, including: Hazmat, Vehicle rescue, Fire Incidents, and Medical Emergencies.

projects.title: Predictive AI Project
projects.description: Currently developing a cloud-native plugin aimed at enhancing public safety workflows through intelligent automation. Leveraging advanced NLP techniques—including BERT and LLMs—for real-time sentiment analysis on transcribed communications. Built with Python, deployed on AWS (S3, EC2) with infrastructure as code via Terraform. Excited about the intersection of AI, public sector innovation, and scalable SaaS solutions.
